== Build (2026-10-23) ==
=== Build notes ===
* Standings from Decipher Report 10 (sealedsummary.html). Schedule from report1.html. Pattern follows [[DecipherCon 1999 Japanese Sealed Deck]].
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Place 38 Jeremy Virgil printed "02 (-31)"; dested as 2 (-31).
* Decipher "all of the Star Wars CCG expansions to date" vs listed First Anthology contents (Premiere, A New Hope, Hoth, Jedi Pack, Special Edition previews).
=== Missing data ===
* No 1997 First Anthology sealed rulesheet. Deck size and game length stay blank. Four preliminary games and a Kessenich vs McCann final are dested from Report 10.
